Subject: Demo request — Dedicated inference for Cascade AI (throughput / latency)

Hi Evelyn,

We self-signed up and started smoke-testing the hosted API but we think we’ll need Redwood Dedicated for predictable latency and data isolation. A few details up-front:

- Target sustained throughput: ~500 qps (inference requests per second)
- Typical input length: 40–120 tokens (avg ~64)
- Desired p95 token latency: <120ms (end-to-end)
- Fallback requirement: automatic degrade to lower-cost model if capacity constrained

Can we schedule a short demo + architecture fit call this week? We’re mostly US-east but have engineers in APAC (Singapore) so a late-afternoon ET / morning SGT slot is ideal.

I attached our capacity worksheet (cascade_capacity_requirements.xlsx) with sample traffic traces. Also looping Alex (ML Platform) — he can join the technical portion.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Singh
Head of Infrastructure | Cascade AI

Hi Priya — thanks for the context and for uploading the sheet. Happy to run a tight, technical demo that covers Dedicated sizing, autoscale/burst behavior, and our latency fallbacks.

A couple of quick Qs before we lock a slot:
- Is the 500 qps steady-state or peak? If it’s bursty, how long are bursts (mins vs hours)?
- Do you have a target geographic routing preference (single region US-East vs multi-region)?
- Will the demo need sample traffic replay (we can run a small replay from your traces)

Proposed windows (ET):
- Thu 21 May 16:00–16:40 ET (works for US & late for APAC)
- Fri 22 May 10:00–10:40 ET (good for US morning + APAC afternoon)
- Mon 25 May 13:00–13:40 ET (fallback)

I’ve attached a short pre-demo checklist that covers items we usually need (model binary, sample traces, API keys). Ben (SDR) and Naomi (AE) are on this thread — they’ll run the scheduling and bring the right ops folks.

If any of these work, reply with your preferred slot and we’ll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior SDR | Redwood Inference

Evelyn / Naomi — cascade_capacity_requirements.xlsx looks clean. A few items for the technical run:
- Confirmed avg seq length ~64; peak seqs go to ~120. That influences KV cache sizing and the latency profile.
- We should ask Cascade whether their 500 qps is inference requests (RPCs) or token-steps. I suspect RPCs.
- GPU suggestion: recommend H100 for steady 500 qps if model is large (>7B) otherwise A100 with quantization might be enough. We’ll surface both cost/latency estimates in the demo.
- For the replay: ask Alex for a small 10-minute trace (we can replay at 1x and 2x to show autoscale).

Naomi — can you confirm whether we want to invite an SRE from Redwood Ops (for dedicated cluster sizing) or keep it just Alex + our L3 infra? My vote: include Ops for any enterprise procurement conversations.
